rule: digest = lower-case hex SHA-256 over UTF-8(domain) || 0x0A || UTF-8(canonical); canonical = RFC 8785 (JCS) of the value input_json parses to

cases.name: execution result
cases.note: A committed create_ticket result, under the execution-result domain.

cases.name: RFC 8785 member order
cases.input_json: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign","\r":"Carriage Return","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
cases.canonical: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}
cases.note: The member-sorting example of RFC 8785 section 3.2.3: names sort by UTF-16 code units.

cases.name: astral key before high BMP key
cases.note: U+1F600 (UTF-16 D83D DE00) sorts before U+FB33. Sorting by code point puts it after: a naive canonicalizer differs here.

cases.name: astral keys among themselves
cases.note: Surrogate pairs compare by their code units.

cases.name: floats
cases.note: ECMAScript number serialization: 1.0 is 1, -0.0 is 0, 1e-7 stays exponential, 0.000001 does not, 1e21 is 1e+21, 2^53+1 rounds to 2^53.

cases.name: integers
cases.note: Integers in the safe range are written as integers.

cases.name: string escapes
cases.input_json: {"s":"quote \" backslash \\ slash / tab \t newline \n cr \r bs \b ff \f nul \u0000 us \u001f del  ls   ps   e-acute é emoji 😀"}
cases.canonical: {"s":"quote \" backslash \\ slash / tab \t newline \n cr \r bs \b ff \f nul \u0000 us \u001f del  ls   ps   e-acute é emoji 😀"}
cases.note: Short escapes for \b \t \n \f \r, \u00xx for other controls; DEL, U+2028 and U+2029 and non-ASCII are written as they are.

cases.name: no Unicode normalization
cases.note: e + combining acute and precomposed e-acute are different names, kept apart.

cases.name: nested order
cases.note: Members are sorted at every depth; arrays keep their order.

cases.name: whitespace in input
cases.note: Whitespace in the input is not part of the canonical bytes.

cases.name: lone high surrogate in a value
cases.note: A lone surrogate cannot be encoded as UTF-8. Refused, never hashed.

cases.name: lone low surrogate in a member name
cases.note: Also refused in a member name.

cases.name: reversed surrogate pair
cases.note: Low then high is two lone surrogates.

cases.name: number out of range
cases.note: Parses to an infinity, which JSON cannot carry. Refused.
